b. What are the processes used to identify work-related hazards and assess risks on a routine and non-routine basis by the entity?

Nelco has an online portal for reporting safety related hazards, incidents, and observations. We have work permit system and SOPs which are strictly adhered to. We also conduct a HIRA exercise, wherein work process related Hazards are identified, risks assessed and mitigation plans monitored. An Apex safety committee along with working committees are constituted to regularly monitor safety needs. The committees conduct safety walks in respective areas to identify and mitigate any safety related observations.

Yes, all staff including permanent and contractual employees and visitors can report work-related hazards through an incident portal or QR code.
